# Toolsaday

> > AI-powered content creation platform offering 700K+ users access to specialized writing tools powered by five AI model tiers (Cheetah, Butterfly, Liger, Puma, Jaguar).

Toolsaday provides a comprehensive suite of AI writing and content generation tools, including flagship products like Text Genie, Story Generator, and Paraphrasing Tool. The platform offers tiered AI models to balance speed and quality across creative writing, marketing, SEO, and business communication use cases.

## Core AI Writing Tools

- [Toolsaday - AI Platform](https://toolsaday.com): Homepage for AI content creation platform with 700K+ users
- [Text Genie](https://toolsaday.com/writing/text-genie): Flagship AI text generation tool with 5 model options (Cheetah to Jaguar)
- [Toolkit Explorer](https://toolsaday.com/toolkit-explorer): Central hub for all Toolsaday writing, SEO, text & image tools
- [Paraphrasing Tool](https://toolsaday.com/writing/paraphrase): AI paraphrasing tool with sentence, paragraph & full-text modes
- [AI Assistant](https://toolsaday.com/writing/chat): AI chat assistant for content creation and marketing tasks
